site.title: Awesome Selfhosted
site.short_description: Community-maintained catalog of self-hosted software — submit via pull request.
site.long_description: The project curates self-hostable tools on GitHub. A merged list entry shows your project URL on awesome-selfhosted.net and in the README. Read CONTRIBUTING before you open a pull request.

opportunities.title: Awesome list pull request
opportunities.description: Open a pull request on the awesome-selfhosted repository. Add your tool in the correct category. List links on GitHub use nofollow. After merge, confirm the entry on awesome-selfhosted.net.

steps.title: Confirm eligibility
steps.body: Read CONTRIBUTING. Your project must be self-hostable and actively maintained.

steps.title: Open pull request
steps.body: Follow the list format on awesome-selfhosted. One entry per tool. Link your homepage or docs URL on your domain.

steps.title: Verify after merge
steps.body: Search for your tool on awesome-selfhosted.net and confirm the outbound link and rel.
